sources.title: EasyRead.AI — AI reading assistant for Chrome
sources.snippet: That depends on your AI setup. Cloud AI receives the content and context needed for your task, with your key used to authenticate the request. A local model receives requests at the address you configure. Chrome built-in AI processes content on your device when supported. We don't track your browsing or store your reading data on our servers.

sources.title: AI Ebook Reader for Mac & iPad — EasyReadAI
sources.snippet: Read EPUB, PDF and TXT on Mac, iPhone and iPad. Capture passages or photograph paper books, check the extracted text, and save local notes with optional AI help.

sources.title: EasyRead.AI
sources.snippet: Say goodbye to lengthy articles and videos, with the power of AI! EasyRead.AI generates high-quality summaries, mind maps or translations based on contents / transcripts.
